[Stage updated 2026-08-31: NCDEQ issued final air-quality permits for Amazon Data Services and Duke Energy Progress, authorizing 588 emergency backup engines at the Airport Road campus in Hamlet and 57 temporary bridge-power engines pending grid connection.]
source: NC DEQ (2026-06-26) | North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality (2026-08-28)
address: Airport Road, Hamlet, NC

name: OpenAI Ohio Data Center
additional_info: OpenAI plans to build a 10-gigawatt data center in southern Ohio, with the first phase delivering 800 MW by 2028. Nvidia is reportedly considering a $250 billion investment in the project.
address: Pike County, OH

name: DataOne / Nebius Vineland AI Data Center
transmission_utility: Vineland Municipal Utilities / Atlantic City Electric
additional_info: Vineland Planning Board approved the second-phase site plan on August 18, enabling a 1.5-million-gallon LNG tank and Bloom Energy fuel-cell installation. Phase 1 was already under construction; the build-to-suit AI facility is for Nebius and supports its Microsoft-related AI infrastructure deployment.
address: 805 Sheridan Ave, Vineland, NJ

name: MLP Ventures Upper Merion Data Center Campuses
additional_info: Upper Merion Township denied preliminary plans and extension requests for five proposed King of Prussia-area data centers totaling more than 4.6 million square feet. The developer indicated it intends to appeal or submit revised plans. The proposal included planned on-site natural-gas turbines and diesel backup generation.
address: Discovery Labs and Renaissance Park, Upper Merion Township (King of Prussia area), PA

name: Project Tamarack
additional_info: Starwood Digital Ventures received West Virginia high-impact data center certification for the $12 billion project. The project is expected to use closed-loop cooling, and the developer has committed to fund project infrastructure costs.
address: Mason County, WV

name: Monarch Compute Campus
additional_info: Nscale's certified Mason County campus was disclosed as requiring 2 GW of power, with closed-loop cooling. Reported client investment commitments rose to $69.2 billion, including a previously announced Anthropic capacity agreement.
address: North of Point Pleasant, Mason County, WV

name: Google Putnam County Data Center Campus
additional_info: Google's planned hyperscale campus near Buffalo is described as comprising up to eight data center buildings served by Appalachian Power. A September update disclosed an MN8-backed 86 MW solar resource, paired with 70 MW of lithium-ion storage and 10 MW of zinc-based long-duration storage, to support Google's regional data center load through PJM.
address: Near Buffalo, Putnam County, WV

name: Project Phoenix
additional_info: Aligned broke ground on a three-facility, 2 GW data center campus in Shippingport Industrial Park, redeveloping a legacy energy site. The campus is planned to use dedicated onsite power rather than local grid supply and is adjacent to the former Shippingport Power Station redevelopment.
address: Shippingport Industrial Park, Shippingport, Beaver County, PA

name: Project Laurel (Limerick Data Center Campus)
additional_info: Proposed AI data center campus on approximately 191 acres at Lightcap, Evergreen and Possum Hollow roads. The conditional-use process remains active; the township's September 22 agenda listed a continued MCD 7 public hearing for October 1, 2026.
address: Lightcap Road, Evergreen Road and Possum Hollow Road, Limerick Township, Montgomery County, PA
